description: "AutoAgent: Fully-Automated and Zero-Code LLM Agent Framework"

summary.one_liner: AutoAgent is a Python framework that lets users create, orchestrate and deploy LLM agents, tools and workflows through natural language alone, with a ready-made deep research mode.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a CLI-driven framework (started with `auto main` or `auto deep-research`) with three modes: a "user mode" multi-agent deep research assistant that handles information retrieval, analysis and report generation, including file uploads; an "agent editor" that creates agent profiles and tools from a conversation; and a "workflow editor" that generates multi-agent workflows from natural-language descriptions (tool creation is not supported in this mode). Agent work runs in a Docker container, which the framework pulls automatically. Model access goes through LiteLLM model names, with support for Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, Gemini, Hugging Face, Groq, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, OpenRouter and DeepSeek. The README also includes scripts to reproduce its GAIA and Agentic-RAG (multihop-RAG) evaluation results and a tip for importing browser cookies and adding third-party tool API keys via process_tool_docs.py.
use_cases: build an LLM agent without writing code
generate multi-agent workflows from a plain-English description
run automated deep research and write research reports
reproduce GAIA or multihop RAG benchmark results
create custom tools for agents through conversation
connect agents to different LLM providers
how_to_run: Install Docker, then create a .env file from .env.template and set GITHUB_AI_TOKEN and the API key for your chosen LLM provider
auto main  (or: auto deep-research for the lighter user mode)
COMPLETION_MODEL=gpt-4o auto main  (set the model per provider, following LiteLLM naming)
notable: Natural-language agent and workflow creation with no manual coding (agent editor and workflow editor)
Deep research user mode, described as a comparable open-source alternative to a paid Deep Research subscription
Broad LLM provider support via LiteLLM model names and OpenAI-compatible endpoints
Reproduction scripts for GAIA and multihop-RAG evaluations
Formerly named MetaChain (renamed in v0.2.0), with an accompanying arXiv paper
caveats: Agent and workflow editor modes require cloning a mirror of the repository and setting git_clone and test_pull_name, so the agent can update itself
Workflow editor does not support tool creation yet
Requires Docker and a GitHub AI token plus LLM API keys; the README says detailed documentation is still coming and a Web GUI is under development
